text: Don't party away your life with the heathen. You walk away from your God at the drop of a hat and like a whore sell yourself promiscuously at every sex-and-religion party on the street.
You'll end up hungrier than ever.
Some of you are going to end up bankrupt in Egypt. Some of you will be disillusioned in Assyria.
